content.user_title: Plan a Clear Paid Advertising Account
content.value_statement: Paid accounts can waste spend when campaigns and keywords overlap. This skill creates a structured plan for campaign types, intent groups, targeting, exclusions, and paid-to-organic overlap.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Search, Performance Max, or broad-match approaches based on stated goals and readiness.
Maps ad groups or asset groups around distinct intent themes.
Defines targeting, match types, negative keywords, and placement or audience exclusions.
Reviews exported campaign, search-term, and GA4 traffic-acquisition data supplied by the user.
Identifies possible paid-to-organic query overlap and marks missing evidence as Unknown.
Produces an Audience-dimension structure assessment for handoff to an account auditor.
limitations: It does not access advertising accounts or analytics accounts without user-provided exports or configured tools.
It does not calculate budget allocation or a final account quality score.
Recommendations depend on the accuracy and completeness of the supplied reports.
Competitive library observations are estimates and do not prove competitor performance.

use_cases.title: Prepare a new account structure
use_cases.description: Choose campaign types and group themes before a new paid search launch.

use_cases.title: Repair overlapping campaigns
use_cases.description: Find internal keyword overlap and create negative or exclusion hygiene for an existing account.

use_cases.title: Review paid and organic overlap
use_cases.description: Compare paid themes with organic landing-page traffic to identify queries that may have limited incremental value.

prompt_templates.title: Start a campaign plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a paid account structure for my lead-generation business. I advertise on Google Ads and target local service searches.

prompt_templates.title: Choose campaign types
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend Search, Performance Max, or broad match for an ecommerce launch. Our goal is profitable new-customer growth, and we have a product feed and image assets.

prompt_templates.title: Organize themes and negatives
prompt_templates.prompt: Create ad groups, match types, and a negative-keyword framework for these themes: payroll software, HR software, and employee onboarding.

prompt_templates.title: Audit supplied exports
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my campaign, search-terms, placements, and GA4 traffic-acquisition exports. Propose a structure, flag overlap, and list evidence that is still missing.

output_examples.input: Choose a structure for a local plumbing lead-generation campaign.
output: Recommended approach: Search campaigns organized by emergency repair, drain cleaning, and water heater intent.
Targeting: service-area locations with separate brand and non-brand coverage.
Hygiene: add job-seeker, DIY, and unrelated trade negatives after reviewing search terms.

output_examples.input: Review paid-to-organic overlap for branded queries.
output: Overlap finding: branded search queries should be separated from non-brand campaigns for measurement.
Evidence needed: branded query costs, conversion data, and organic landing-page traffic.
Status: do not assign an incrementality conclusion until the missing data is available.

best_practices: Provide recent campaign, search-term, placement, and analytics exports when available.
Use one clear intent theme per ad group or asset group.
Treat recommendations as a review plan and confirm changes before applying them.
anti_patterns: Do not mix unrelated intents in one ad group just to reduce campaign count.
Do not infer performance conclusions from missing placement or conversion data.
Do not use this skill as a substitute for budget allocation or final account auditing.

faq.question: Can this skill log in to my advertising account?
faq.answer: No. Provide exports or use approved account tools when available.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It supports planning concepts for paid advertising platforms, especially Search and Performance Max workflows.

faq.question: Does it set budgets?
faq.answer: No. Budget allocation is outside this skill scope.

faq.question: Can it find negative keywords?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose negative and exclusion hygiene from supplied search-term data and themes.

faq.question: Does it calculate final ROAS?
faq.answer: No. It assesses the Audience dimension and structure only when applicable evidence is complete.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the campaign goal, platforms, target themes, and recent campaign, search-term, placement, or analytics exports.
